SELECT c.parent_id AS parentId, c.id AS childId, c.appeal_no AS appealNo, c.title AS title, c.content AS content, o.id AS orderId, o.status AS orderStatus, o.department AS department, o.street_office AS streetOffice, o.is_archived AS isArchived, o.dispose_time AS disposeTime, o.close_time AS closeTime, (ev.id IS NOT NULL) AS evaluated FROM appeal_child c LEFT JOIN work_order_appeal woa ON woa.appeal_id = c.id LEFT JOIN admin_work_order o ON o.id = woa.order_id AND o.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN order_evaluate ev ON ev.order_id = o.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id IN #{pid} ORDER BY c.parent_id ASC, c.id ASC

SELECT wo.category, AS region, ac.title, ac.content FROM appeal_child ac LEFT JOIN work_order_appeal woa ON woa.appeal_id = ac.id LEFT JOIN admin_work_order wo ON wo.id = woa.order_id WHERE ac.status = 'ORDERED' AND ac.is_deleted = 0 AND wo.category IS NOT NULL AND ac.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) ORDER BY ac.create_time DESC LIMIT 5000
